description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Undying Malice.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Undying Malice.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
